reading.body:
CyrusOne Allen holds 77 MW of published IT capacity, second among 19 Texas facilities with disclosed power, but its compliance certifications and lack of announced expansion limit its AI scaling role.

The campus spans 976,000 square feet and carries HIPAA, FISMA, PCI DSS, ISO 27001, SSAE 16 Type II, and Green Globes certifications. These regimes serve regulated tenants, not the unrestricted compute that large AI training clusters typically require. At 77 MW, the campus could support roughly 1,900 racks at 40 kW per rack, but that assumes a density the operator does not state.

The suitability score of 76 rests on published IT capacity and operator type, with announced expansion missing. Texas has 133 data center sites but publishes capacity for fewer than one in seven, so this campus is one of the few with disclosed power. Whether it becomes an AI cluster depends on future expansion or repurposing, neither of which the specifications state.
